name: NY-16
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent George Latimer running for reelection
Republican challenger has reported no fundraising
model.rationale: Latimer holds a D+18 seat with incumbency advantages, while his opponent shows no measurable fundraising and markets price the race at 96% Democratic. With no polls or expert ratings, the fundamentals-based margin of roughly 24 points stands.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending targeting the seat would be the first sign the race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Westchester-based NY-16 leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 18 points, and first-term incumbent George Latimer is running for reelection. He has raised over $500,000 for the cycle, while Republican Joseph Cinquemani reports no fundraising activity, leaving the challenger badly outmatched financially.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put the Democratic win probability at 96%. The fundamentals point to a comfortable incumbent win in the mid-20-point range, consistent with the district's profile and the absence of any competitive signals.
